text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Good! And excelleeeent! You pass, girls!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... C-Could it be you heard what we 
were just saying...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Teaming up with your rival to take on the 
world...! It's so dazzling it makes me 
dizzy!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Working together to create a gift fit for 
the world! Right? Of course I heard!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Strike while the iron is hot! 
Where should we start?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Pearl-senpai, are you planning to 
do it too? Together?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's right. So rest easy now! 
After all, the world-class me has 
arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What should we do... We were just 
talking about making a birthday present 
for Pearl-senpai..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, Pearl-senpai seems to be having so 
much fun with it...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if it's come to this, let's 
reveal the truth at the very end and frame 
it as a present!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come! Let us go claim the world!!
